commands.name: progress
commands.description: Show or hide the workflow progress bar; "done" closes this branch's item

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: Show or hide the pane listing every work item in this repository

tools.name: stage
tools.description: Record the dotnet-workflow-kit pipeline state for this branch: the progress bar's state file. Pass `stage` with `fields` to merge into stages.<stage> (done, artifactUrl, decision, note, waiting, ...; `at` is filled when done is true), `current` for what the bar shows now, and `item` (ticket, title, shortTitle, order) when the item starts. Fields left out keep their value. Finds or creates the file itself.

children: No work items in this repository yet. /start begins one.

props.label: Notify me when another session needs me: Off

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
